sys_atf_test.name: Day-2 negative: requester == approver fails preflight (SoD)
sys_atf_test.description: A request whose approver_id equals requester_id must be refused by the gate pre-flight with a CM-5 separation-of-duties reason, and must never actuate.

sys_atf_step.description: Submit the identical id as both requester and approver; assert the gate refuses and names CM-5.
Assert no request advanced to Closed Complete on this path (state != 3).
